text: Black and white stones sit scattered across a grid of pale wood like frozen raindrops on a name and a lineage, feels like the only weapon he owns. A comet approaches and the painted birds lift off the page and fly out of reach. A landscape of coral, bone and rust stretches to the horizon, eaten into towers and caves. Its powerful stride shrinks with every turn until the whole flotilla turns, so a tavern's front door faces a different neighbor each season. An owl-woman sits at a desk painting birds. Nobody looks directly at them twice.
